en: Psalms 37

p.src: By David.

en: By David.
u.src: By David.

p.src: 1  Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.

en: Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.
u.src: 1  Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.

p.src: 2  For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.

en: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.
u.src: 2  For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.

p.src: 3  Trust in the LORD, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.

en: Trust in the LORD, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.
u.src: 3  Trust in the LORD, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.

p.src: 4  Also delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

en: Also delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
u.src: 4  Also delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

p.src: 5  Commit your way to the LORD. Trust also in him, and he will do this:

en: Commit your way to the LORD. Trust also in him, and he will do this:
u.src: 5  Commit your way to the LORD. Trust also in him, and he will do this:

p.src: 6  he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.

en: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.
u.src: 6  he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.

p.src: 7  Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.

en: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.
u.src: 7  Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.

p.src: 8  Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.

en: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.
u.src: 8  Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.

p.src: 9  For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for the LORD shall inherit the land.

en: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for the LORD shall inherit the land.
u.src: 9  For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for the LORD shall inherit the land.

p.src: 10  For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.

en: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.
u.src: 10  For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.

p.src: 11  But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

en: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
u.src: 11  But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

p.src: 12  The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.

en: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.
u.src: 12  The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.

p.src: 13  The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.

en: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.
u.src: 13  The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.

p.src: 14  The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.

en: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.
u.src: 14  The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.

p.src: 15  Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.

en: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.
u.src: 15  Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.

p.src: 16  Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.

en: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.
u.src: 16  Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.

p.src: 17  For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.

en: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.
u.src: 17  For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.

p.src: 18  The LORD knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.

en: The LORD knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.
u.src: 18  The LORD knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.

p.src: 19  They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

en: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
u.src: 19  They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

p.src: 20  But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of the LORD shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.

en: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of the LORD shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.
u.src: 20  But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of the LORD shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.

p.src: 21  The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.

en: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.
u.src: 21  The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.

p.src: 22  For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.

en: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.
u.src: 22  For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.

p.src: 23  A man’s steps are established by the LORD. He delights in his way.

en: A man’s steps are established by the LORD. He delights in his way.
u.src: 23  A man’s steps are established by the LORD. He delights in his way.

p.src: 24  Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for the LORD holds him up with his hand.

en: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for the LORD holds him up with his hand.
u.src: 24  Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for the LORD holds him up with his hand.

p.src: 25  I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.

en: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.
u.src: 25  I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.

p.src: 26  All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.

en: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.
u.src: 26  All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.

p.src: 27  Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.

en: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.
u.src: 27  Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.

p.src: 28  For the LORD loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.

en: For the LORD loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.
u.src: 28  For the LORD loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.

p.src: 29  The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.

en: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.
u.src: 29  The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.

p.src: 30  The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.

en: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.
u.src: 30  The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.

p.src: 31  The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.

en: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.
u.src: 31  The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.

p.src: 32  The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.

en: The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.
u.src: 32  The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.

p.src: 33  The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

en: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
u.src: 33  The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

p.src: 34  Wait for the LORD, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.

en: Wait for the LORD, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.
u.src: 34  Wait for the LORD, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.

p.src: 35  I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.

en: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.
u.src: 35  I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.

p.src: 36  But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.

en: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
u.src: 36  But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.

p.src: 37  Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.

en: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.
u.src: 37  Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.

p.src: 38  As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.

en: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.
u.src: 38  As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.

p.src: 39  But the salvation of the righteous is from the LORD. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.

en: But the salvation of the righteous is from the LORD. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
u.src: 39  But the salvation of the righteous is from the LORD. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.

p.src: 40  The LORD helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.

en: The LORD helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.
u.src: 40  The LORD helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.
